title: Remove Zero Sum Consecutive Nodes from Linked List
summary: Given a linked list, remove all consecutive sequences of nodes that sum to zero.
statement: Given a linked list, remove all consecutive sequences of nodes that sum to zero. Return the modified linked list head. Multiple valid answers are acceptable.
constraints: Remove every consecutive zero-sum segment, including segments exposed by earlier removals.
reference_solution:
def remove_zero_sum_sublists(head):
 dummy=ListNode(0,head);prefix=0;last={}
 node=dummy
 while node:prefix+=node.val;last[prefix]=node;node=node.next
 prefix=0;node=dummy
 while node:prefix+=node.val;node.next=last[prefix].next;node=node.next
 return dummy.next

hints: Equal prefix sums enclose a zero-sum node segment.
Use a dummy zero node so removals may include the original head.
Map each prefix sum to its last node, then make each node skip to the node after that last occurrence.
Using last occurrences removes the widest zero-sum region and also handles segments revealed by deletion.
editorial: Using last occurrences removes the widest zero-sum region and also handles segments revealed by deletion.
